jobs.description:
CMT is looking for a highly motivated and collaborative IT Security Engineer to join the CMT team. Reporting to the leader of IT Engineering, you will work in a highly collaborative role mostly focused on the execution of assigned tasks relating to information technology security, infrastructure, and IT managed cloud solutions. This role will also serve as a Tier-3 escalation point for our internal Help Desk. This is a highly collaborative role, and communication skills are critical. This is a hybrid role that requires in-office presence at CMT’s Budapest, Hungary, office at least 3 days per week, or as the work demands.

CMT is looking for a **Senior IT Security Engineer** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

**Responsibilities:**

- Using independent judgment, execute assigned tasks in an efficient and effective manner
- Collaborate with colleagues to implement and update IT processes and infrastructure
- Design and implement solutions and controls that support adherence to CMT policy
- Proactively investigate and remediate emerging vulnerabilities impacting endpoints and Saas tools
- Apply established security frameworks to IT processes and infrastructure, ensuring configurations and workflows align with CMT policies
- Understand security governance control and implement best practices in IT-controlled environments (SaaS, email security, IdP, etc.)
- Collaborate with security stakeholders and other IT personnel on security-related projects
- Perform regular security audits on IT systems with little to no supervision
- Provide incident support when needed, which includes, but is not limited to, response, containment, remediation, and go-forward activities
- Participate in tabletop exercises when needed
- Respond to security detections, reviewing alerts for false positives or providing next steps for remediation
- Advanced understanding of Datadog’s product and technology, including advanced queries and alert configuration
- In-depth knowledge of Jamf’s Security Cloud offering
- Research, recommend, and implement new technologies and features
- Apply scripting and code development knowledge to identify security risks within code artifacts, scripts, and packages as needed
- Collaborate with leadership in documenting and continuously improving IT security policies, procedures, and incident response processes
- Complete any additional tasks as they arise

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in a related field
- 4+ years of experience with macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Windows management in an enterprise environment in a security role
- 4+ years of relevant working experience in IT Security
- Understanding of common cloud provider ideologies
- Excellent verbal and communication skills
- Excellent written and spoken English skills

**Nice to Haves:**

- Practical experience executing security-centric tasks
- Experience with, AWS management, Tableau, OneLogin, Sophos, and G-Suite preferred
- CompTIA Security+
- Jamf 200+ Certification
- (ISC)2 CISSP, CCSP, or SSCP

**Compensation and Benefits:**

- Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience
- Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
- Private healthcare
- Life and disability insurance
- Parental leave
- Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities

**Base Salary Range**

- The base salary range for this position is: 19,234,100 to 24,042,600 HUF. This range is specifically for Budapest, Hungary.

**A** **dditional Perks:**

- Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world
- Join an industry leader — 65+ million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries
- Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified
- Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety
- Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters
- High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact
- Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge
- Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA+, Women, Book Club, and Health & Wellness
- Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:**

At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai

**A** **bout Cambridge Mobile Telematics:**

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world’s largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world’s roads and drivers safer. The company’s AI-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date,

CMT’s technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, LAUNCH

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained launch cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Willing to work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

Job Description An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we re committed to being a great place to work one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.
Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.
Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.
Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.
Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required
Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.

Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.
Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.
Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.
Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.
Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Skills

Cloud Infrastructure Management - Setting up, configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the components of cloud infrastructure.
Computer Networking - A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources.
Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
DevSecOps - A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and pas well as continuous delivery and a security first approach.
General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) - The process of managing and provisioning infrastructure through code instead of through manual processes.
IT Infrastructure Management - Planning, design, delivery and control of information technology infrastructure.
Performance Monitoring - The process of measuring the performance of a system in real time in order to determine problems and identify other factors that may cause problems in the future.
Policy Management - The process of creating, implementing and maintaining policies and procedures within an organization.
Process Automation - Also known as business automation or digital transformation, this is the technology-enabled automation of complex business processes. It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.
Service Delivery Management - The manner in which an organization provides users access to IT services, which include applications, data storage and other business resources.
Systems Administration - Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, system configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access control.
System Platform- A system platform refers to the underlying foundation or framework that supports and manages the operation of software applications and hardware components within a computing environment. It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.
Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.
Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.
AI Platform Reliability &
• Incident Management Operating AI agents and automation platforms in production, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post incident remediation.

Enterprise ALM &
• Release Management Managing solution promotion, version control, and coordinated releases for low code and AI solutions across environments.

Data Integration &
• Connector Strategy Integrating Power Platform and AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources while managing connector risk and performance.

Identity, Access &
• Permissions Modeling Designing and enforcing role based access, service accounts, managed identities, and secure permission models.

Cost Awareness &
• Optimization (FinOps) Monitoring usage patterns and identifying optimization opportunities for AI, automation, and platform services.

Platform Standardization &
• Pattern Development Defining reusable patterns, reference architectures, and templates for AI agents, workflows, and low code applications.

Change Management &
• Adoption Enablement Supporting rollout, operational readiness, and adoption of AI enabled digital workplace capabilities.

Vendor &
• Third Party Platform Coordination Partnering with vendors to resolve issues, influence roadmaps, and evaluate emerging capabilities.

Risk Assessment &
• Compliance Alignment Assessing AI and platform solutions against security, privacy, regulatory, and audit requirements.

Technical Communication &
• Executive Readouts Translating platform and AI operational data into clear, decision ready insights for leadership.

Your Career

As the Principal for Competitive Intelligence within the Cortex Product Management organization, you are the strategic link between the competitive landscape and our product roadmap. By applying Structured Analytic Techniques (SATs) to technical competitive data, you will provide the "Inconvenient Truths" that challenge our product assumptions and ensure that Cortex maintains a structural architectural advantage validated by evidence and field reality.

Qualifications

Your Impact

Own the Agentic Endpoint Security Competitive Picture. AES is a fast-moving market where today's architecture decisions define tomorrow's winners. You will maintain a continuously updated, evidence-based view of how the competitive landscape is evolving and translate it into product decisions that keep Cortex ahead.Separate Architecture from Marketing. The AES market conflates detection with enforcement, posture with runtime, and rule-based blocking with behavioral detection. You will produce rigorous technical teardowns that distinguish what competitors actually do from what they claim — and make sure our teams know the difference.Define the Counter-Narrative. You will identify patterns across wins and losses in this space and deliver the objective analysis Product and Engineering need to respond.Track the Analyst Narrative. Category definitions in AES are still being written. You will monitor how analysts are framing the space and ensure our product and messaging strategy stays ahead of placements that shape enterprise procurement decisions.

Experience running adversarial workshops for product launches — simulating how competitors will attempt to undercut new capabilities in the field.

* Own EE platforms in Mexico: Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Endpoint Engineering platforms that power the device lifecycle in MX (e.g., Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE, SnipeIT/Jira Assets, Assets inventory ecosystem, Zero Touch tooling, internal APIs).
* Build features \& integrations: Design and implement features, APIs, and data flows that connect MDM, inventory, Jira Service Management, NuEx App, vendor systems, and other internal platforms.
* Automation \& self-service: Create automations and self-service experiences that eliminate manual work, reduce ticket load, and increase reliability for onboarding, replacements, and everyday device workflows.
* DevOps ownership: Act as the DevOps owner for these platforms in MX: manage infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Ansible/Puppet or similar), CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, observability, and incident hooks.
* Metrics \& outcomes: Define and track key platform and experience metrics (e.g., ZTD success rate, Time-to-Productivity, ticket deflection, inventory correctness, audit readiness) and iterate based on data.

**Operational Ownership**

* Day-to-day operations in MX: Be the technical owner of the daily health, performance, and SLOs of Endpoint Engineering platforms and device fleets in Mexico.
* Incidents \& on-call: Lead incident response within the MX scope for EE platforms, coordinate with the global on-call rotation, and drive high-quality post-mortems and follow-ups.
* Lifecycle runbooks: Maintain and continuously improve runbooks and documentation for key device lifecycle journeys: onboarding, day-to-day support, replacements, offboarding, and panic/lost-stolen flows.
* Cross-team execution: Partner closely with TechCenter, Global Security Operations, Global Services Platforms, REWS, Finance, and HR to ensure asset lifecycle processes are executed consistently and safely.
* Operational excellence: Proactively analyze observability signals (logs, metrics, alerts) to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation before they become incidents.

**Global Scale \& Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner across NuEx and BAs: Collaborate with global Endpoint Engineering, NuEx, BA product/ops, Security, and infra/office tech teams on initiatives like NuEx App, Jira governance, Atlas, and security foundations.
* Scale MX learnings: Turn lessons learned in Mexico into reusable patterns---playbooks, automations, data models, and dashboards---that can be adopted by Brazil, Colombia, and other regions.
* Hiring \& bar-raising: Participate in hiring loops (interviews, exercises, leveling feedback) for Endpoint Engineering roles, helping maintain and raise the engineering bar at Nubank.
* Mentorship: Mentor and pair with IC3/IC4 engineers (and contractors where appropriate), reviewing designs and pull requests, and fostering a strong engineering culture in Endpoint Engineering.

**Regulatory \& Compliance Support**

* As the deepest technical expert on the ground, serve as the reference point when regulatory bodies require explanations of our systems and processes.
* Ensure platform documentation and configurations are audit-ready as a byproduct of good engineering hygiene.

**We are looking for a person who has
Must-have**

* Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* Operating systems: Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting macOS, Windows, and Linux in production environments.
* Programming \& scripting: Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Clojure, Go, Java) and in scripting (e.g., Shell Script); comfortable building services, tools, and automations.
* Cloud \& backend: Experience designing and operating cloud-based services on AWS (e.g., Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch, Workspaces or similar) or another major cloud provider.
* DevOps \& IaC: Strong DevOps fundamentals---Git and CI/CD, containers (Docker), configuration management and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet or similar), and solid observability practices.
* Databases: Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL/SQL Server or similar) as part of building or integrating services.
* Language \& location: Native or near-native Spanish, fluent English; legally authorized to work and resident in Mexico City, with willingness to work on-site multiple days per week.

**Device Management**

* MDM expertise: Production experience with Apple-focused MDM solutions (Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE) and Zero Touch Deployment flows at scale.
* Policy \& compliance: Ability to design, implement, and maintain endpoint security and compliance policies via MDM and related tooling (e.g., certificates, identity agents, Zscaler or similar).
* Troubleshooting: Proven track record of debugging complex device setup and connectivity issues (authentication, VPN, certificates, agents, network restrictions) across macOS, Windows, and mobile.

**Inventory \& Asset Management**

* Inventory platforms: Hands-on experience with IT inventory/asset management and CMDB platforms (e.g., SnipeIT, Jira Assets, ServiceNow, Device42 or similar).
* Lifecycle modeling: Ability to model and operate end-to-end device lifecycle workflows (procurement, onboarding, day-to-day, replacements, leasing, returns, offboarding, panic/lost-stolen) in tools like Jira Service Management and internal services.
* Integrations \& data quality: Experience integrating inventory data with HR, vendors, finance, and internal platforms, and driving data quality and governance to keep inventory audit-ready.

**AI Native**

* AI fluency: Ease in using AI tools as part of day-to-day work---exploring logs and metrics, prototyping automations, generating or refining runbooks and documentation, and improving support experiences.
* Experimentation mindset: Willingness to experiment with AI/ML-powered approaches to observability, incident response, and operational automation, while keeping security and compliance requirements in mind.

**Nice to Have**

* Regulated environments: Experience working in financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries, including exposure to audits or regulatory reviews.
* Endpoint Eng stack: Familiarity with Clojure microservices, Zscaler or similar secure access solutions, and Zero Trust-style endpoint/identity architectures.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications such as Linux (RHCE/LPIC), AWS, Jamf Pro, or security-related certifications.
* Product \& UX mindset: Experience partnering with product, UX, and operations to run discoveries, talk to internal users, and instrument user experience metrics (e.g., CSAT, Time-to-Productivity, ticket deflection).

**Location for this opportunity**

* Mexico City, Mexico

**Our Benefits**

* Chance of earning equity at Nu
* Extended maternity and paternity leaves
* Health and life insurance
* Dental and Vision Insurance
* NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
* Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
* NuLanguage - Our language learning program
* Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year
* 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus
* Gym partnership
* Food card
* Work-from-home Allowance
* Parental Consultancy
* Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

**Work Model for this Role**

* Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence--enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

jobs.description:
### **Company Overview**

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit [https://network.id.me/](https://network.id.me/).

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found [here](https://insider.id.me/candidate-ai-use-in-interviewing/).

## IT Engineer, IT Operations

### Role Overview

We are seeking an **IT Engineer** to join our **IT Operations team** — the group that keeps the core systems a ~1,000-person company runs on, reliable, secure, and continuously improving. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes ownership end to end: you will build the integrations and automations that connect our IT and business platforms, keep critical services highly available, and be a dependable technical resource the rest of the team can rely on.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy. Much of the work here isn't handed to you fully specified — you will investigate unfamiliar systems, reverse-engineer how things fit together in a fast-moving environment, and decide what's worth doing next. You will ship pragmatically, favoring solid, incremental improvements that land over perfect solutions that don't, and you will keep Security, Compliance, and Data close so everything you build stays governed. Throughout, you will raise issues early, communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and help the people around you.

If you like owning hard problems in a complex environment, working independently, and being the calm, capable engineer a team is glad to have, this is a meaningful opportunity to shape how our IT organization operates.

### Role Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain integrations and automations that connect our IT and business systems, eliminating manual, repetitive work.
- Administer, configure, and optimize core IT platforms and business SaaS applications, ensuring consistent performance and reliability.
- Script and deploy solutions organization-wide (Python, Bash, or similar) and automate repeatable operational processes.
- Integrate systems through APIs and webhooks — handling authentication, rate limits, retries, and error cases.
- Handle advanced technical troubleshooting across IT systems, endpoints, identity, and integrations, and support escalations from the IT Support team.
- Implement proactive measures for high availability, monitor system performance, and remediate availability and performance issues before users feel them.
- Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execution, ensuring swift restoration of critical services.
- Proactively identify improvements to systems and processes, then scope and deliver them without waiting to be told.
- Create and maintain clear documentation, configuration standards, and runbooks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Partner with engineering, security, and compliance teams to develop responsible, well-governed solutions.
- Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to the overall capability of the IT Operations team.
- Communicate technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly and calmly to teammates and stakeholders.
- Perform other duties as assigned to meet team and organizational needs.

### Required Skills / Abilities

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as an IT / systems engineer (or similar) in an enterprise environment, able to carry technical work independently.
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- Strong API fluency (REST / JSON, OAuth, webhooks) and the ability to read and write code in Python, Bash, or similar.
- Demonstrated experience integrating and automating across SaaS platforms and business systems.
- Experience with applying AI and LLM-based automation to reduce operational toil.
- A self-starter who works with a high degree of autonomy — identifies what needs doing, gathers context independently, and drives it to completion.
- Comfortable operating amid ambiguity and incomplete documentation, quickly building understanding of unfamiliar and fast-changing systems.
- Solid fundamentals in systems administration, corporate directory / identity, networking, and endpoint management.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the maturity to keep stakeholders informed and to raise risks constructively.
- A pragmatic, iterative delivery style — ship "good enough, then iterate" rather than stalling on perfection.

### Ideal Qualifications

_The qualifications below are ideal, but not all are required. We encourage candidates to apply if they satisfy some, but not all of these qualifications._

- Experience with MDM solutions (Jamf, Intune) and supporting macOS at scale.
- Familiarity with modern automation and workflow tooling, and version control systems.
- Experience with monitoring, observability, and building resilient, highly available services.
- Relevant industry certifications.

jobs.description:
Minnesota - Software Engineer

Hollstadt Overview
Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down-to-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations.

Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran.

By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.

Job Description

Role: End User Compute Engineer

Location: Onsite in Lakeville, MN, with travel to Northfield, MN 1 day every 3 weeks

Duration: 1 year

Rate: $35/hour W2

Position Summary

We are seeking an End User Compute Engineer to provide hands-on technical support and endpoint management for a growing enterprise environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues, delivering exceptional customer experiences, and serving as a trusted technology partner across the organization.

You will support a broad range of end-user technologies, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, collaboration platforms, and conference room technologies. In addition to day-to-day support, you'll play an important role in improving endpoint management, patching strategies, conference room reliability, and overall user productivity.

This opportunity offers a mix of technical troubleshooting, executive support, endpoint administration, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement, making it an excellent fit for someone who enjoys both operational support and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

End User Support & Issue Resolution

Resolve technical issues from a prioritized support queue, ensuring timely and professional service.
Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, and end-user computing issues across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, printers, phones, and peripherals.
Provide support for both onsite and remote employees while maintaining a consistent user experience across locations.
Deliver high-touch support to senior leaders and key stakeholders when required.
Communicate clearly with users, provide status updates, and ensure issues are fully resolved.

Collaboration & Meeting Technology Support

Support, maintain, and troubleshoot conference room technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, video conferencing systems, digital displays, projectors, and related AV equipment.
Ensure meeting rooms are operational, reliable, and ready for business-critical meetings.
Assist with deployment and optimization of collaboration technologies across multiple sites.

Endpoint Administration & Device Management

Configure, deploy, secure, and support endpoint devices in accordance with enterprise standards.
Utilize endpoint management platforms such as Intune, ManageEngine, or similar tools to manage devices and software.
Support endpoint security initiatives, including BitLocker, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on technologies, and compliance requirements.
Develop and enhance endpoint patching and software deployment processes to improve reliability and reduce risk.

IT Operations & Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, and productivity teams to resolve complex technical issues.
Support enterprise technology initiatives, including software rollouts, system upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
Manage and prioritize requests through the IT service management platform.
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.

Continuous Improvement

Identify recurring issues, analyze trends, and recommend long-term solutions.
Conduct proactive system checks and preventative maintenance activities.
Help improve support processes, workflows, and user experiences across the organization.
Provide training, guidance, and knowledge sharing to end users and junior support staff.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in IT support, desktop engineering, endpoint management, or a similar end-user computing role.
Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, hardware, peripherals, and collaboration technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise endpoint technologies, including device configuration, deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
Experience administering and supporting:

Windows Enterprise environments
Active Directory
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office applications)
Group Policy
BitLocker
Single Sign-On (SSO)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Experience with IT ticketing and service management platforms such as ServiceNow or similar tools.
Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues independently.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to lift up to 45 pounds when supporting endpoint and conference room equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms, conference room technologies, and audio-visual systems.
Experience providing executive or white-glove support to senior leadership.
Familiarity with endpoint management tools such as Intune, ManageEngine, or Lansweeper.
Basic PowerShell scripting experience for automation and administration tasks.
ITIL certification or practical knowledge of ITIL service management principles.
Experience supporting hybrid work environments and remote employees.
Familiarity with compliance, security audits, or regulated environments.
Experience independently leading small endpoint management or user technology improvement projects.

Technical Environment

Candidates can expect to work with technologies including:

Windows Enterprise
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office Suite)
Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR)
Active Directory
Intune
ManageEngine
Lansweeper
ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
BitLocker
MFA and Single Sign-On technologies
Group Policy
Mobile device management tools
Printers, VoIP phones, and enterprise peripherals
PowerShell
Video conferencing and audio-visual systems

What Success Looks Like

Successful individuals in this role are highly customer-focused and take ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution. They combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with professionalism, empathy, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

You will thrive if you:

Enjoy solving complex technology problems in fast-paced environments.
Build trust through clear communication and follow-through.
Can balance urgent support needs with long-term process improvements.
Work effectively across multiple IT teams and business groups.
Take a proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing issues before they impact users.
Are comfortable supporting everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.
Continuously seek opportunities to improve technology, processes, and the overall user experience.

Why Join This Opportunity

Play a visible role supporting critical business users and technology solutions.
Work with a broad range of modern endpoint, collaboration, and workplace technologies.
Gain exposure to enterprise-scale IT operations and cross-functional initiatives.
Help shape endpoint management, patching, and support processes that directly impact employee productivity.
Enjoy a varied role that combines hands-on technical support, project work, collaboration technologies, and continuous improvement efforts.
Join a team that values service excellence, operational reliability, and technology innovation.

Travel: Less than 5%

Additional Expectations: Occasional after-hours support and on-call responsibilities as needed.

Benefits + Perks

Comprehensive Benefit Plan

Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between!

Remarketing Process

Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise.

Professional Development

Hollstadt offers on-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI).

401k + Matching

One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor.

Bonus Opportunities

We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000!

Ongoing Support & Networking

We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team - so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

Our Values
Respect | Belonging | Accountability | Transparency

Department
Information TechnologyJob Summary The End User Computing (EUC) Engineer is responsible for designing, supporting, maintaining, and optimizing the hospital's end user computing environment to ensure clinicians, staff, and administrators have reliable and secure access to technology resources. This role provides advanced technical support for endpoint devices, operating systems, applications, and mobility solutions, with a strong focus on delivering a stable, compliant, and user-friendly experience in a healthcare setting. The Engineer partners closely with clinical and non-clinical teams to address technology needs, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute to projects that enhance patient care through technology.

Essential Functions
Endpoint Deployment & Configuration o Build, configure, and deploy desktops, laptops, tablets, thin clients, and mobile devices using enterprise imaging and management tools.
o Ensure devices meet hospital security, compliance, and operational standards prior to release.

(15%)

Advanced Technical Support o Provide Tier II/III support for escalated incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
o Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and peripheral issues in clinical and administrative environments.

o Partner with EUC Support and Help Desk teams to ensure resolution and knowledge transfer.

(15%)

Systems & Application Management o Administer and support Microsoft 365, Intune, SCCM, and other enterprise endpoint management solutions.
o Package, test, and deploy applications, patches, and updates to the endpoint environment.

o Maintain and optimize Group Policy Objects (GPOs), login scripts, and device configurations.

(15%)

Healthcare Technology Integration o Support clinical workstations, Workstations on Wheels (WoWs), printers, and medical-grade peripherals.

(15%)

o Participate in vulnerability remediation, patch management, and compliance reporting activities.

(15%)

o Assist with design, testing, and rollout of new endpoint standards, technologies, and configurations.

o Document project deliverables, lessons learned, and standard operating procedures.

(10%)

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing o Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
o Provide technical training and guidance to junior staff and end users as needed.

(10%)

Continuous Improvement o Monitor system performance, identify recurring issues, and recommend solutions to improve reliability and efficiency.
o Stay current with emerging EUC technologies, industry best practices, and healthcare IT trends.

(5%)

Education
Bachelor's Degree Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field required; equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of degree.
Work Experience
7-9 years of IT experience with at least 5 years focused on end user computing required.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Windows Operating Systems, Intune, SCCM, Active Directory, Group Policy.Experience with mobile device management (MDM/MAM), such as Intune, JAMF or Citrix XenMobile.Familiarity with clinical workflows and healthcare endpoint technologies.Strong troubleshooting skills in hardware, OS, and application environments.Shift
Days (United States of America)Work Type

RegularSalary
$88,800.00 - $137,600.00 / yr

Benefits
At Denver Health, we take care of the people who take care of our community. Our benefits are built to support your life, your family, and your future — with generous paid time off, fully paid parental leave, exceptional retirement contributions, comprehensive health coverage, and nationally recognized well-being programs. We invest in your growth through tuition assistance, career advancement pathways, and professional development — while also offering meaningful financial advantages through loan forgiveness eligibility and employer contributions.

When you join Denver Health, you’re joining a mission-driven organization that invests in you.

Here is a small list of our benefit programs:

Paid time off starting at 28 days per year, inclusive of vacation, personal/sick, and 7 Holidays 100% paid parental leave up to 6 weeks Immediate eligibility for retirement plans with employer contribution up to 9.5% Generous medical, dental, vision plans in addition to employer paid disability and life insurance. Comprehensive well-being programs including on-site employee fitness center located on Denver Health main campus and nationally recognized RESTORE Center Free RTD EcoPass (public transportation) Childcare discount programs & exclusive perks on large brands, travel, and more Tuition reimbursement & assistance Education, coaching, and professional development opportunities through the Workforce Development Center (WFDC) that support internal career growth and advancement pathways Professional clinical advancement program & shared governance Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible employer+ free student loan coaching and assistance navigating the PSLF program National Health Service Corps (NHCS) and Colorado Health Service Corps (CHSC) eligible employer

Located near downtown Denver, Denver Health is just minutes away from many of the cultural and recreational activities Denver has to offer.

Description

If you’ve done this before in B2B SaaS, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CT, FL, GA, ME, MA, NJ, NC, NY, OH, TN, & VA.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full pre-sales technical experience for Enterprise Partners, Channel, MSPs & Customers. Scripting experience in PowerShell, JavaScript, &/or VBScript is strongly preferred. Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure. Technical certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus.

By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. jobs.summary: Mission Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce...
jobs.description:
Mission

Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce poste de direction stratégique et technique combine des compétences en architecture cloud, en environnement de travail moderne, en sécurité, en gestion des identités, en collaboration et en infrastructure afin de fournir des services numériques sécurisés, évolutifs, résilients et centrés sur l’utilisateur.

L’architecte dirige le comité cloud, qui fait office d’instance d’approbation pour l’adoption et le déploiement de nouveaux services cloud au sein du groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Stratégie et architecture cloud

• Définir et maintenir la stratégie et la feuille de route d’entreprise relatives au cloud Microsoft.

• Concevoir des architectures cloud sécurisées, évolutives, hautement disponibles et rentables.

• S’assurer que les solutions cloud sont en adéquation avec les objectifs métier, les exigences de sécurité et les normes de conformité.

• Mettre en place des « Azure Landing Zones » et des modèles de gouvernance du cloud.

Architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique

• Définir la vision et l’architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique.

• Concevoir des plateformes de collaboration et de productivité à l’aide de Microsoft 365.

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation de l’environnement de travail favorisant le travail hybride et à distance.

• Améliorer la productivité des collaborateurs et leur expérience numérique grâce à des services innovants liés à l’environnement de travail.

Identité, sécurité et conformité

• Concevoir la gestion des identités et des accès de l’entreprise à l’aide de Microsoft Entra ID.

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre une sécurité « Zero Trust » Principes de sécurité.

• Concevoir des solutions d’accès conditionnel, de gouvernance des identités, d’authentification multifactorielle (MFA) et de gestion des accès privilégiés.

• Mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité maîtrisant : la suite Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, la prévention des pertes de données (DLP) et la protection des informations.

Garantir la conformité aux réglementations du secteur et aux politiques d’entreprise.

Gestion des terminaux et des appareils

• Définir une stratégie moderne de gestion des terminaux.

• Diriger l’initiative Microsoft Intune.

• Mettre en oeuvre : Windows Autopilot, la gestion des appareils mobiles (MDM), la gestion des applications mobiles (MAM), la sécurité des terminaux et les politiques de conformité des appareils

Leadership technique

• Agir en tant qu’autorité technique senior pour les technologies cloud et d’environnement de travail.

• Diriger les comités d’examen de l’architecture et les comités de gouvernance technique.

• Définir les normes d’ingénierie et les meilleures pratiques.

• Servir de point de relais pour les problèmes techniques critiques.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences

• Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans les infrastructures informatiques, le cloud et les services liés à l’environnement de travail.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans la conception de solutions cloud Azure.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans l’architecture d’environnements Microsoft 365 d’entreprise.

• Expérience avérée dans la direction de programmes de transformation numérique et de migration vers le cloud.

• Expérience dans la gestion de plateformes cloud et d’environnement de travail à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

• Solide expérience en matière de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des identités.

Compétences techniques requises

• Technologies cloud : Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, AzureSurveillance, Azure Backup & Recovery, gouvernance Azure, gestion des coûts Azure.

• Microsoft 365 : Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive Entreprise, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.

• Sécurité et identité : Microsoft Entra ID, accès conditionnel, gestion des identités privilégiées (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, architecture Zero Trust

• Gestion des terminaux : Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, gestion des appareils mobiles

• Automatisation et DevOps : PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, API Microsoft Graph

Certifications souhaitées :

Microsoft Certified : Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Microsoft 365 Certified : Enterprise Administrator Expert

Microsoft Certified : Cybersecurity Architect Expert

Microsoft Certified : Identity and Access Administrator Associate

Microsoft Certified : DevOps Engineer Expert

Microsoft Certified : Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

About the position

We are seeking an Endpoint Management Engineer to design, automate, and operate the enterprise device management platform supporting our global workforce, laboratories, manufacturing sites, and commercial field organization. This role owns hands-on engineering and operations across Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) in a co-management architecture, with Hybrid Entra ID (Azure AD) joined, Active Directory domain-bound Windows endpoints and a multi-platform Intune estate spanning Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android — including Android-based teleconferencing and conference room systems.
Automation is central to this role. The successful candidate writes production-quality PowerShell, Bash, and .NET code, builds Intune remediation and detection scripts, and uses the Microsoft Graph API to manage the estate programmatically rather than soley through the console. We also expect fluency with modern AI-assisted engineering tools — including Claude or CoPilot — to accelerate script development, log analysis, documentation, and reporting.
Equally important is the discipline required in a regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will advance modern management objectives — Zero Trust, Conditional Access, cloud-first policy delivery, and progressive workload migration from Configuration Manager to Intune — while respecting the reliability requirements of standard corporate devices and the constraints of non-standard, purpose-built systems such as laboratory instrument controllers, manufacturing workstations, kiosks, and validated GxP endpoints. The role partners closely with Information Security, Identity, Networking, Infrastructure, Site IT, and Site Service Support teams.

Responsibilities

Design, write, and maintain production-quality PowerShell for endpoint provisioning, configuration enforcement, bulk administration, reporting, and incident remediation across the Windows estate.Write and maintain shell/Bash scripts for macOS configuration, compliance validation, and application delivery through Intune macOS shell scripting.Build and manage Intune Remediations (proactive remediations) — paired detection and remediation script logic — to identify and self-heal configuration drift, failed agents, certificate issues, and compliance gaps without user impact.Automate platform operations against the Microsoft Graph API, including device and policy inventory, assignment management, application lifecycle tasks, reporting extracts, and integration with adjacent systems.Apply engineering discipline to automation assets: source control, code review, parameterization, error handling, logging, idempotency, and controlled release through test rings.Convert recurring manual and Service Desk activities into automated or self-service capabilities.Engineer and maintain Intune compliance policies across all platforms, including device health, OS version floors, and custom compliance scripts.Build and maintain configuration profiles and settings catalog policies, administrative templates, and custom OMA-URI/configuration profiles for Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android.Familiar with Windows Update for Business and update rings, feature and quality update deployments, driver and firmware update governance, macOS and iOS update policies.Manage monthly and out-of-band patch operations in Configuration Manager through Software Update Groups, automatic deployment rules, and maintenance windows; drive patch compliance to defined service-level targets and remediate delinquent endpoints.Package, test, and deploy applications across platforms — Win32 (.intunewin), MSI/MSIX, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 Apps, macOS PKG/DMG and shell-script apps, iOS/Android managed apps via volume purchasing — with correct detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, requirement rules, and assignment logic.Implement and maintain security baselines and industry benchmarks — Microsoft security baselines for Windows, Edge, and Defender; CIS Benchmarks; DISA STIG-derived controls — including deviation tracking, exception documentation, and drift detection.Administer the Configuration Manager hierarchy: site systems, distribution points, boundary groups, client health, content distribution, task sequences, OS deployment, and hardware/software inventory accuracy.Manage non-standard Windows endpoints — laboratory instrument PCs, manufacturing and shop-floor workstations, kiosks, shared and standalone systems — with tailored collections, restricted patch windows, exception handling, and documented deviations.Manage device identity across Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including Hybrid Entra ID join, Entra ID join, AD domain-bound systems, and resolution of stale, duplicate, or mis-registered device objects.Configure and maintain co-management settings, pilot collections, and the controlled transition of individual workloads (compliance policies, Windows Update, device configuration, client apps, Office Apps) from Configuration Manager to Intune.Support Conditional Access in partnership with Identity and Information Security: device-based and compliance-based grant controls, filters for devices, app protection policy requirements, and safe rollout using report-only mode and exclusion groups.Understand and support macOS Platform SSO with Entra ID — Secure Enclave authentication, local account creation and password sync, registration during Automated Device Enrollment — and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in for macOS and iOS/iPadOS.Familiar with Zscaler Client Connector or comparable Zero Trust network access and secure web gateway agents across Windows and macOS.Familiar with endpoint security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker and FileVault encryption with key escrow, application control, firewall policy, and Windows LAPS.Deploy and maintain certificate profiles (SCEP/PKCS) and Wi-Fi (including 802.1X) across all supported platforms.Define, publish, and maintain endpoint management KPIs — patch compliance rate and time-to-patch, policy and compliance jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
