jobs.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re...
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

- Approach all rollouts with a strong user experience focus. Phasing thoughtfully, communicating proactively, and designing for minimal disruption

- Contribute to designing and implementing best practices, policies, and procedures for the Device Infrastructure Services team

- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization

- Be available for occasional 24/7 on-call shifts to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve incidents.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf.

The IT Tooling team sits within IT Support & Services (ITSS) and builds the automations that power ITSS's own operations. Our in-house bot, Ask IT, deflects the majority of company-wide IT requests before they reach a human. Beyond that, we automate ITSS's core day-to-day workflows — ticket triage, access reviews, onboarding and offboarding — which employees experience as self-service. You'll own technical domains within the IT Tooling platform and partner with regional IT teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER through platforms including n8n, Jira, Okta, Airflow, and Temporal.

Required Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of experience in IT engineering, automation, or systems engineering, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions, engineering standards, or platform-level systems that others build on top of

jobs.description:
Truveta provides unprecedented real-world data and real-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate regulatory-grade evidence, and improve patient care. Today, Truveta enables research on more than 130 million de-identified patients across the US.

Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values .

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking candidates inspired by the opportunity to securely apply data in the development of real-world health solutions. Beyond core capabilities, we seek problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. We do things the right way. Our commitment to security and compliance assurance cannot be stressed enough. This position is critical to ensuring we are successful.

If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.

This Opportunity

The successful candidate will design and support solutions that support the company’s Digital Workplace strategy. They will work on leading edge technologies that help modernize endpoint management by leveraging the cloud to quickly deliver end-user improvements.

Responsibilities:

- Device Management: Define, implement and maintain endpoint hardening baselines for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems with MDM such as Microsoft Intune, and JAMF.

- Policy & Hardening: Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures for all endpoint devices. Implement system hardening configurations based on industry best practices.

- Deploy & Manage Security Tools: Implement, configure, and maintain endpoint security solutions, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), antivirus/anti-malware software, and host-based firewalls.

- Incident Response: Collaborate with IT and Security team to respond to endpoint-related incidents. Triage, remediate, and contain security incidents and threats on endpoints. Perform forensic analysis when necessary.

- Vulnerability Management: Manage the endpoint vulnerability lifecycle, from discovery and assessment to remediation, using scanning tools and patch management systems.

- Patch Management: Design and oversee the deployment of updates, security patches for operating system and applications.

- Automation & Scripting: Develop scripts and automation (e.g., using Python, PowerShell) to streamline security operations, automate repetitive tasks, and improve response times.

- AI Protection: Secure endpoints used for AI development, including devices accessing model weights, training data, and production inference systems, implementing guardrails on AI tool usage (e.g., prompt injection prevention in local LLM dev tools, restricted plugins/add-ons).

- Data Loss Prevention: Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) and encryption policies on devices used to handle sensitive AI training datasets, including PHI/PII and proprietary corporation data.

- On-call: Ability to participate in On-call rotation.

- On-site: This position requires daily onsite work at Truveta office in Hyderabad.

Qualifications

- Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience in an endpoint security, cybersecurity engineering, or similar role.

- Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of modern operating systems (Windows, macOS) and their architecture, configuration and deployment in a large enterprise environment.

- Cloud Experience : Strong hands-on experience on Azure Cloud PC, VM, Azure Firewall and Azure Networking.

- MDM Expertise: Strong hands-on experience on Microsoft Intune and JAMF administration, such as device enrollment, OS upgrade/patch, configuration, profile.

- Policy Management: Define and assign compliance/security policies to ensure corporation devices meet organizational security standards.

- Application Management: Strong hands-on experience on applications control, deployment, patch and upgrade.

- EPM: Proven experience with industry-leading EPM platforms such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust to control user privileged access and provide advanced threat protection and vulnerability management.

- Networking: Solid understanding of TCP/IP IPv4/v6, experience of office network (Routing / Switching / WAN, Wi-Fi & Security) management and network security concepts.

- Security Principles: Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE), threat intelligence, and incident response methodologies.

- Compliance: Experiences with SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, and ISO compliance frameworks. Interact with the compliance team to ensure the company compliant and remediate gaps during compliance finding and controls.

- Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication/presentation, ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Enterprise Engineering organization manages one of the largest macOS client fleets in the world. We are a team of builders managing the solutions for Amazon's global macOS client fleets. We use AWS products to evolve traditional enterprise tools and services at a large scale.

We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer with extensive macOS knowledge of Fleet Management, troubleshooting expertise, development background, and strong knowledge of macOS performance troubleshooting. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy working with others, and like to solve technical challenges, keep reading. In this role, you and your team will directly influence Amazon's macOS experience roadmap. You will use native AWS services, external 3rd party services, and DevOps patterns to manage a growing fleet of macOS client devices. This is a hands-on position where your daily activities include macOS administration, integrations, developing tools and automation, root cause analysis, performance analysis, and maintaining service infrastructures. You will contribute to operations and development activities as we build the next generation of macOS management tools.

Every day will bring new and exciting opportunities. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Troubleshoot and solve issues in a globally scaled enterprise environment
macOS client management — patching, OS updates, configuration profile deployments, and MDM policy enforcement
Maintain client management service infrastructure hosted in AWS
Contribute to automation efforts with a primary focus on the macOS client fleet

Key job responsibilities

- Build automation and tooling using scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash) to streamline operations and reduce manual work

- Create operational documentation (runbooks, standards, guides). Partner with Engineering on infrastructure projects

- Strong proficiency in macOS and Windows endpoint administration

- Solid experience with endpoint management platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune)

- Proficiency in at least one scripting language (PowerShell, Python, Bash)

- Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery solutions (Veeam, Time Machine)

- Experience with collaboration platforms (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace)

Positions on TCS require a TS/SCI clearance to be eligible for hire; with the ability to successfully pass a government polygraph as a post-hire requirement.

Overview
A career with Johnson County Government is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to serve a diverse and expanding community in meaningful ways. We challenge ourselves to be a different kind of government because we care deeply about our community and each other. Committed to our shared values, we provide excellent public service, seeking always to improve ourselves and our organization. We offer wonderful benefits, retirement plans, wellness incentives, a great organizational culture, and much more! If you’re searching for something more than just a job, something akin to a calling, then consider the challenge and opportunity of being a member of Johnson County Government!

Job Description
Johnson County's Department of Technology and Innovation (DTI) delivers innovative and reliable technology solutions and services to advance the objectives of County staff, elected officials, and the community in a cost effective and efficient manner. DTI is looking to fill the position of Endpoint Engineer (System Administrator I). This position will be part of the Endpoint Engineering team focused on ensuring all the supported endpoint devices, such as desktops, laptops, thin clients, and tablets, are proactively and strategically managed, and continues to be secure, patched, and supported.

Applications will be accepted through April 22, 2026.

The Endpoint Engineer (System Administrator I) position is responsible for software installations and deployments, patch management on endpoints, and overall client management. Additional duties include the following:

Establishes system specifications by conferring with users; analyzes workflow, access, information, and security requirements. Develops tactical solutions for routine system support, by resolving day-to-day problems for end users of Microsoft Active Directory and other 3rd party applications.
Confers with vendors; develops, tests, evaluates, and installs enhancements and new software. Develops system access; monitors, controls, and evaluates system performance for integrity of data through proper security groups, email distribution lists, external accounts, resource accounts and system permissions; maintains Active Directory user/email accounts through security requests and identifies unused accounts to ensure application of security practices and policies; establishes and tests disaster recovery policies and procedures; completes back-ups, restores information as necessary; maintains documentation.
Maintains system performance of physical and VMWare virtual servers by performing system monitoring, analysis, and performance tuning; installs and upgrades new Windows server hardware and software; applies patches, hot fixes and Service Packs; troubleshoots system hardware, software, networks and systems management; designs and runs system load/stress testing; escalates application problems to vendor.
Develops system access; monitors, controls, and evaluates system performance; establishes and tests disaster recovery policies and procedures; completes back-ups; maintains documentation. Plans, documents and implements projects for new technology and system functionality; coordinates work with other team members for timely completion; analyzes the network server infrastructure for capacity planning.

Job Requirements
Associate’s degree in the following field(s) of study: Information Technology or related field and two (2) years work experience in systems design, programming, systems software and support are required.

Experience with Microsoft Office 365, SCCM, Antivirus Administration, and aBachelor’s degree in the following field(s) of study: Information Technology or related field are preferred.

Experience can substitute for education.

Johnson County Government requires reference/background screening for all positions.

This position is currently eligible to work in a hybrid work environment with both onsite and remote work, after initial training period. Residency within the Kansas City-Overland Park-Kansas City, MO-KS Combined Statistical Area, which generally includes the Kansas counties of Johnson, Wyandotte, Leavenworth, Miami, and Linn, and the Missouri counties of Jackson, Clay, Platte, Cass, and Ray, is required.

Physical, Environmental, and Special Working Conditions:

All County employees may be called upon to assist other departments/agencies in a declared emergency situation.

jobs.description:
The End User Computing Engineer will support, manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of Goodwill’s end-user computing environment consisting of desktop, mobile devices, printers, POS devices and peripherals across the enterprise.

RESPONSIBILITY LEVEL:

Implements strategies to achieve the goals for the organization and IT infrastructure environment. Implements, revises, and sustains policies, procedures and programs. Typically works on projects and initiatives that span 3 – 12 months.

The End User Computing Engineer will support, manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of Goodwill’s end-user computing environment consisting of desktop, mobile devices, printers, POS devices and peripherals across the enterprise. The desktop engineer also accepts ownership for various projects and implements initiative and assists in the design and planning of POS projects, while providing tier two/three support for other engineers and support team members.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES:

1. Provides strategic, innovative and cost-effective solutions to increase efficiency, reliability, and integration of our EUC services and operations.

2. Develops lifecycle and asset management processes.

3. Develops strategic management processes, including new application and upgrade evaluations.

4. Tests new or enhanced applications including systems enhancements and provides feedback.

5. Deployment of Windows using Microsoft Autopilot.

6. Project and Change Management: Effectively plans and manages own work to reliably complete routine job responsibilities and special assignments. May serve as a team member or subject matter expert on formal projects or within the department. Effectively engages in change affecting her/him, communicating appropriately with supervisor. Follows through on learning, skill building, and practice necessary to adapt to change.

7. Problem Solving: Light supervision; works independently. Periodic review of work by manager or senior coworker. Solves problems of moderate to advanced complexity; able to identify root cause, interpret data and resolve issues.

8. Technical Skill: Understands and applies professional principles and skills within area of specialization to modify processes to resolve situations.

9. Community Engagement: Champions Goodwill’s community engagement initiatives and serves as an ambassador for Goodwill in the wider community.

10. Complete all other duties/responsibilities as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. Associate’s degree or equivalent experience and 3-4 years experience.

2. Excellent customer service skills.

3. Experience with Active Directory

4. Proven ability to provision and troubleshoot O365 accounts.

5. Basic network troubleshooting skills.

6. Experience in Windows Autopilot services setup and deployment.

7. Deep knowledge in Software packaging and distribution using SCCM.

8. Must have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license and proof of vehicle insurance, as this position may require some travel between locations and the transportation of equipment.

9. Legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

SKILLS:

1. Ability to work in a semi-autonomous and fast-paced environment.

2. Good Knowledge and experience in Intune configurations, policies and management.

3. Hands on experience in managing Windows Devices with co-management.

CORE CULTURAL COMPETENCIES:

1. Customer Focus: Independently anticipate and meet customer needs, while searching for ways to improve customer service. Internalize customer feedback, and follow up with customer to ensure problems are solved by providing innovative ideas to meet their future needs.

2. Values Differences: Seeks out the diverse perspectives and talents of others, striving to work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds or styles. Behave with sensitivity towards differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Challenge stereotyping or offensive comments.

3. Communicates Effectively: Shares information and updates with others, while ensuring a clear, concise and professional communication through reports, documentation, written and other communications. Listens with interest to what others have to say.

4. Situational Adaptability: Demonstrates flexibility of responses to different situations through adapting to the changing needs, conditions, priorities or opportunities. Monitors how well an approach is working to see if a change is needed, recognizing cues that suggest a change in approach or behavior is needed.

5. Drives Results: Demonstrates a strong drive to achieve meaningful results, through driving tasks to successful completion and closure. Sets high standards for own performance, showing determination in the face of obstacles and setbacks.

6. Ensures Accountability: Takes responsibility and ownership for successes and failures in own work. Monitors progress of performance and changes approach accordingly, following through on commitments.

PHYSICAL/SENSORY DEMANDS:

Ability to remain stationary for extended periods. Repetitive use of hands is required in the form of fine manipulations while using a computer keyboard. Must be able to communicate effectively in verbal and written form. Vision is required to transfer written information into electronic databases. Prolonged periods of visual concentration are required. Ability to lift, push and pull a minimum of 50 pounds. Ability to travel between Goodwill locations as needed.

When determining placement within the salary range for this position Goodwill Greater Milwaukee & Chicago considers education, experience, internal equity, market demands and other qualifying criteria. It is not typical for individuals to be hired at or near the top of the rage for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on facts and circumstances of each case.

Certain roles are eligible to participate in an incentive plan. Participation in this plan does not guarantee an incentive payment and is subject to the terms and conditions of the plan, which are subject to change.

Who we are:

Farm Credit Bank of Texas is a $42.2 billion wholesale bank that has been financing agriculture and rural America for over 100 years. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we provide funding and services to rural lending associations in five states, and we are active in the nation's capital markets.

While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.

We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.

Position Description: The End-User Computing Engineer is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and securing the Bank's End-User Computing (EUC) environment. This role serves as a technical resource for the implementation, management, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, and related end-user services.

Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Engineer collaborates closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to maintain reliable, secure, and efficient EUC services. The role provides advanced technical expertise, third-tier support, and engineering solutions that improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance the overall user experience.

The position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of the Bank's endpoint computing environment through proactive administration, automation, and continuous improvement. The End-User Computing Engineer leverages technical expertise to support modern workplace technologies, streamline operations, and deliver solutions that align with the Bank's business objectives and technology strategy.

Operating with a high degree of ownership and accountability, the End-User Computing Engineer identifies improvement opportunities, resolves complex technical issues, implements technology enhancements, and helps ensure that employees have secure and reliable access to the systems and tools they need to perform their work effectively.

Day-to-Day Duties and Responsibilities: Monitor and maintain enterprise EUC services to ensure acceptable levels of performance, reliability, and availability. Perform advanced troubleshooting, problem resolution, and preventative maintenance for desktop, endpoint, and virtual desktop technologies. Provide third-tier technical support and technical guidance to Customer Support and other IT teams. Administer and support desktop operating systems, endpoint management platforms, mobile devices, and related technologies. Enhance system security through endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security-focused engineering practices. Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational support materials. Create and maintain automation solutions and scripts that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and optimize operational processes. Manage assigned EUC systems and services, ensuring consistent performance, support, maintenance, and lifecycle management. Track work requests, operational activities, incidents, and project tasks through the Bank's IT service management processes. Communicate infrastructure updates, maintenance activities, and technology changes to management, support teams, and end users as appropriate. Support operating system and application deployment, patching, packaging, and update management activities. Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Services, and application teams to support technology initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement efforts. Participate in the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new technologies that improve the employee computing experience and support the Bank's strategic objectives. What You Bring to the Team: Our ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments and enjoys working in a collaborative, customer-focused technology organization dedicated to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

This role requires a combination of endpoint engineering, systems administration, automation, troubleshooting, and customer service expertise, including:

Associate's degree, technical school certification, or equivalent technical experience. Professional certifications in Microsoft, Omnissa, VMware, or related technologies preferred. Three (3) or more years of experience as a Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, End-User Computing Engineer, or similar technology role. Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and experience may be considered. Experience administering enterprise Windows environments, desktop platforms, and endpoint management solutions. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues. Experience supporting desktop operating systems, mobile devices, endpoint security, and end-user productivity tools. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of service, accuracy, and attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across cross-functional technology teams. Commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality technical support and engineering solutions. Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, and systems management tools. Experience supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), including Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop environments. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automated platform management. Experience with endpoint security technologies, vulnerability management, and remediation programs. Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365 applications, and modern workplace technologies. Experience with Windows Autopilot, device provisioning, and modern desktop deployment methodologies. Experience administering cloud-based computing environments, including Microsoft Azure. Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring solutions such as ControlUp. Experience supporting collaboration and conferencing technologies including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related platforms. Experience working within regulated financial services, banking, or highly controlled technology environments. Why Farm Credit Bank of Texas: In addition to a competitive salary, we offer comprehensive, affordable, and competitive benefit options that are focused on health and wellness, financial security, and achieving a work-life balance:

Flexible health-and-wellness benefits, including medical insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental insurance, vision care, flexible spending accounts, and more. 401(k) plan that includes immediate vesting of a generous employer match and additional employer contribution. Long-term disability and life insurance. Vacation leave, sick leave, and paid holidays. Fertility benefit and parental leave plan. Up to two days per year to volunteer in local community organizations, services, or events. Ongoing professional-development opportunities. Generous tuition-reimbursement program. Physical fitness incentive plan. Employer matching gifts program. Important note: We care about your hiring process and take it seriously. A real person will review your applications, meaning response timelines may vary. The interviewing process at Farm Credit Bank of Texas may include phone calls and emails, on-site interviews, and requests for portfolios or demonstrations of work. We can\'t personally follow up with each applicant, and we will do our best to create a professional, respectful, and thorough process for candidates with whom we identify as a potential fit.

About the Role

We are growing and expanding our Endpoint Management & Security product team and are looking for a Product Manager to join a group of PMs working together on the capabilities that power NinjaOne's approach to reducing attack surface, including risk analysis and remediation, across managed endpoints. This role reports to the Director of Product Management and operates as part of a highly collaborative PM team focused on building and evolving the tools IT and security teams rely on to keep endpoints secure and risk exposure low.

This role covers capabilities that sit at the intersection of IT operations and security, helping customers spot where they're exposed and take action to close those gaps before they become problems. While these capabilities are deeply technical in nature, this is a product role focused on defining the right features, workflows, and abstractions that allow IT teams and MSPs to identify, prioritize, and remediate risk across their endpoint fleet efficiently, safely, and at scale. We're looking for someone equally comfortable in IT operations and security contexts — candidates with a background in either (or both) are encouraged to apply.

You will work closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners to shape product direction, define roadmaps, and deliver high-impact capabilities that strengthen customers' security posture across their environments. You'll also collaborate closely with other Product Managers to ensure NinjaOne continues to lead the market in how modern endpoint management platforms are designed, used, and evolved.

If you enjoy building core product capabilities, working close to real-world IT and security use cases, and helping define what "great" looks like when IT operations and security work as one, we'd love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, ME, MA, MD, NJ, NC, NY, OR, TN, TX, VA, & WA.

Work closely with engineering, design, support, and other stakeholders to bring new capabilities from concept to delivery, ensuring features are well-defined, usable, and solve real customer problems. Customer & Market Insight
Engage with customers, MSPs, and internal teams to understand how endpoint management and security features are used in practice. Translate those insights into product improvements and new capabilities. Product Craft & Execution
Write clear product requirements, define workflows and edge cases, and ensure features are delivered to a high standard. Iterate based on feedback and usage data. Platform & Ecosystem Thinking
Ensure capabilities work cohesively across NinjaOne and enable other product areas to build on top of them effectively. Other duties as needed

Comfortable working closely with engineers and understanding technical concepts without needing to write production code. Proven ability to take product features from idea to delivery and iterate based on customer feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Data-informed decision maker who balances customer needs, product quality, and business priorities. Able to influence and align stakeholders without formal authority. Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM / SCCM)

Configure Enrollment Status Page behavior, Autopilot profile assignments, and troubleshoot enrollment and provisioning issues.
Package and deploy Win32, Microsoft Store, Microsoft 365 Apps, and line-of-business applications; manage application lifecycle and update processes.
Configure and maintain security baselines, BitLocker management, Endpoint Privilege Management, Microsoft Defender integration, and Conditional Access integration.

Co-Management & Endpoint Modernization

Design and implement MECM/Intune co-management solutions and migrate workloads between MECM and Intune.
Develop endpoint modernization roadmaps that guide customers from traditional device management to cloud-native management.

Automation, Documentation & Reporting

Integrate endpoint management workflows with Microsoft Graph API where applicable.
Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and implementation guides.
Develop reports using MECM, Intune, Power BI, SQL, and Microsoft reporting tools to track deployment success, compliance, and endpoint metrics.
Provide Tier 3 escalation support and mentor junior engineers or support staff.

Strong experience with Windows 10 and Windows 11 deployment, management, and troubleshooting.
Experience with operating system deployment, application packaging/deployment, patch management, endpoint security, and device compliance.

jobs.description:
Description
The Corporate Technology Group designs, deploys, and supports Bloomberg’s platforms and systems used by more than 21,000 employees across 170+ offices worldwide. The team supports critical infrastructure services that enable internal applications, data platforms, engineering workflows, and enterprise operations across Bloomberg.

What’s the Role?
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you’ll help engineer, operate, and improve Bloomberg’s globally distributed Windows hosting and SQL Server database services. You will bring strong hands-on Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server administration experience, with enough infrastructure awareness to troubleshoot across virtualization, storage, networking, identity, and application dependencies.

We’ll Trust You To

Engineer, support, and troubleshoot governed Windows Server environments, including configuration, patching, clustering, Active Directory integration, platform services, and lifecycle management.
Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server services, including installation, configuration, patching, backup/restore, security, performance troubleshooting, availability, failover clustering, and operational support.
Diagnose complex service issues across Windows Server, SQL Server, Active Directory, DNS, service accounts, networking, storage, virtualization, and application dependencies.
Improve monitoring, alerting, telemetry, service health reporting, documentation, and operational handoffs to reduce risk and improve supportability.
Identify and deliver improvements that simplify processes, reduce manual effort, increase automation, and improve the consistency of service delivery across the global operating model.
Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, preventative engineering, and operational readiness for business-critical platform and database services.
Partner across engineering, operations, application, database, security, and infrastructure teams to plan and execute platform and database service changes safely and effectively.

You’ll Need to Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or equivalent platform, systems, and database services experience.
4+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise Windows Server environments, Microsoft SQL Server, hosted application platforms, or related infrastructure services.
Strong Windows Server administration experience, including troubleshooting, patching, Active Directory integration, DNS, Group Policy, service accounts, SPNs, DFS, clustering, and related platform services.
Strong hands-on Microsoft SQL Server administration experience in an enterprise environment, including installation, configuration, patching, backup/restore, security, troubleshooting, performance, and high-availability technologies.
Working knowledge of the infrastructure dependencies that support Windows and database services, including virtualization, storage, networking, backup/recovery, and operational monitoring.
Working knowledge of PowerShell, SQL/T-SQL, Python, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and operational discipline, with the ability to take ownership of complex issues and collaborate across engineering disciplines.

We’d Love to See

Experience with SCCM or similar tools for Windows operating system deployment, software deployment, patching, and configuration management.
Working knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code practices, or tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or similar.
Experience creating runbooks, playbooks, operational readiness reviews, support handoff documentation, and ITSM knowledge articles.
Experience working in a global technology environment supporting business-critical Windows, platform, or database services.
Exposure to private cloud, hybrid cloud, platform hosting technologies, or service migration initiatives.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Splunk, Falcon, Humio, or similar tools.

Salary Range = 130,000 - 225,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

Job Description As a Workplace Engineer/Analyst, you will be a key member of the Corporate Workplace & Collaboration team, responsible for engineering, operating, and improving the global Modern Workplace ecosystem.

You will serve as a technical expert for managed devices, Intune, Windows, endpoint security, update governance, Windows 365, and supporting technologies that enable secure, stable, and efficient user experiences across the organization.

You will ensure that Workplace platforms are delivered in a consistent, scalable, and policycompliant manner, aligned with corporate IT standards and global cybersecurity requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as the subject matter expert for Intune, Windows, device management, compliance policies, update channels, and workplace endpoint technologies. Design and implement Modern Workplace solutions, including Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance baselines, Windows update governance, and mobile device management. Act as technical lead in global Workplace Engineering initiatives such as device standardization, Windows365 deployments, endpoint security rollouts, and modernization projects. Act as Tier 3 escalation point for complex endpointrelated incidents, including Windows, iOS/Android, Intune policy conflicts, MDM enrollment, compliance failures, and security agent deployments. Execute nonstandard service requests requiring deep engineering knowledge (e.g., selective policy overrides, exception handling, certificatebased integrations, advanced troubleshooting). Develop and maintain documentation, runbooks, best practices, baseline definitions, and operational procedures. Collaborate with external partners such as Microsoft, service and hardware vendors, and security partners to support Workplace initiatives and troubleshoot advanced issues. Maintain uptodate knowledge of Modern Workplace technologies, Windows management best practices, hardware evolution, and MDM/endpoint security trends. Support Mergers & Acquisitions activities related to device migration, Intune onboarding, Windows image alignment, and policy standardization. Apply strong analytical and problemsolving skills to diagnose and resolve endpoint and devicerelated technical challenges efficiently.

Qualifications 3+ years' hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, endpoint engineering, Modern Workplace operations, and Microsoft 365 environments. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Intune (Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, update rings, application deployment), Windows 10/11 enterprise environments, and device lifecycle management. Experience with mobile device management (iOS/Android), Microsoft 365 services (Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive), and Azure AD / Entra ID with endpoint security and compliance. Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. Microsoft certifications (Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management, Azure, Security), Windows 365 experience, and knowledge of certificate-based authentication or identity-driven security are a plus. Experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow). Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, stakeholder management, project coordination, technical communication, and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Additional Information Why SGS?

Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry. Enjoy a flexible schedule and hybrid work model Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus. Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents. Benefit from a comprehensive benefits platform. Apply Now:
At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and hands-on enterprise experience supporting modern workplace technologies.Hands-on enterprise experience with Microsoft Intune for device and application managementProven experience deploying and managing Windows Autopilot for device provisioning and lifecycle managementStrong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including users, groups, devices, and Conditional AccessExperience supporting Microsoft Azure and cloud-based workplace servicesDeep understanding of Windows 11, modern device management, and endpoint security conceptsStrong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills in an enterprise environmentMicrosoft certifications such as MD-102, SC-300, AZ-104, or MS-102 are preferred

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a Senior Endpoint Engineer to join our team on a contract supporting the Department of Homeland Security. As a Senior Endpoint Engineer, you will be part of a dynamic team of windows cloud engineers and security specialists with expert experience in Windows, Intune, Autopilot, Enterprise Patching, PKI/Certificates, Azure Active Directory, Virtualization, Cloud, and scripting experience. In this role, you will work across endpoint management and server operations teams driving automation through scripting and testing of new/emerging technologies to deliver faster deployments and decreased workload.

Responsibilities:

\- Support Intune administration and engineering, to include compliance policies for conditional access, application deployment and patching, management and troubleshooting

\- Use Windows Update for Business to keep Windows workstations patched to correct levels

\- Create and deploy Intune configurations, policies, and settings

\- Manage and maintain Windows 11 workstation baseline configurations

\- Support and troubleshooting for Windows Autopilot

\- Identify, analyze, and resolve system problems with both short-term workarounds and long-term solutions

\- Package software and updates for deployment in the test and production environments.

\- Develop security baselines based on the recommendations from the Engineering and Security teams.

\- Create reports on device compliance, application deployment, patch management, and software inventory

\- Write PowerShell scripts to automate systems administration tasks

\- Respond to escalated service desk/team requests

\- Provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced systems engineers

\- Communicate effectively (in oral and written form) with a variety of individuals; work well within small and large team environments

\- Serves as liaison with clients, participating in meetings to ensure client needs are met

\- Participates in special projects as required

Qualifications:

Required:

\- Ability to attain DHS EOD

\- BA + 10 years’ applicable experience, AA + 12 years’ applicable experience or 16 years’ experience

\- Intune experience, supporting software packaging and patching

\- Windows Autopilot experience

\- EntraID (AzureAD) experience

\- Expert knowledge of packaging, testing, deployment, and issue remediation

\- Solid knowledge of PowerShell scripting

Desired:

\- ITIL v3 or v4 certification

\- MCSE Certified

\- Endpoint Administrator Associate certification (Microsoft 365)

\- STIG Policy experience

\- Vulnerability Management experience

\- Cloud Management experience

\- AVD Management

-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Endpoint Management & Engineering Own and continuously improve the modern endpoint management platform, including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, and related technologies. Manage the full Windows endpoint lifecycle, including provisioning, enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, patching, OS upgrades, troubleshooting, and retirement. Lead the transition from SCCM/MECM and Group Policy–based management to modern, cloud-native endpoint management, including decommissioning legacy infrastructure. Experience migrating from SCCM/GPO-based environments to Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management. Experience managing Apple Business Manager, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android devices through Intune. Experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot or Security Copilot) to improve endpoint automation, troubleshooting, reporting, and documentation. Ability to modernize legacy endpoint practices while maintaining business continuity. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Security-first mindset with practical understanding of user experience and operational supportability. Ability to work independently while collaborating across multiple technical teams. jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on IT professional to support endpoint deployment and management, user support, Microsoft 365 services, and office IT operations in a research and corporate environment.

The successful candidate will serve as a key member of the IT team responsible for workstation lifecycle management, onboarding and offboarding activities, endpoint security and compliance, and day-to-day technical support for end users. The role also provides opportunities to develop automation solutions and participate in Linux, storage, and research computing initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

Deploy, configure, and support Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including provisioning, maintenance, and retirement
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware deployment, software configuration, account provisioning, and access management
Administer and support Microsoft 365 services, including Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and Microsoft Defender
Provide first- and second-level technical support for endpoint, application, networking, and user-related issues
Maintain endpoint standards, inventory, deployment processes, and device compliance
Support datacenter operations, environmental monitoring and datacenter infrastructure systems
Support office IT infrastructure, including networking, printers, conference room technology, and Teams phone services
Develop and maintain automation solutions and operational tools using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies
Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and user guides

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
5+ years of IT systems administration, endpoint management, or IT operations experience
Strong experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting Windows desktop and laptop systems
Experience supporting Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Teams, and Microsoft Defender
Experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS systems
Experience managing endpoint lifecycle processes, including onboarding, deployment, maintenance, and retirement
Experience administering helpdesk or IT service management platform
Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoint, application, and networking technologies
Familiarity with networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VLAN concepts
Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar tools
Excellent customer service, communication, and organizational skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience administering Linux desktop and server systems
Experience supporting physical security, access-control, or facility management systems

Physical Demands

Ability to lift and carry computer equipment and peripherals weighing up to 35 lbs.
Frequent standing, walking, bending, and reaching to install or repair equipment.
Ability to climb ladders or step stools to access network cabling or mounted devices.
Manual dexterity to operate tools, handle small components, and connect cables.
Visual acuity to read technical manuals, labels, and computer screens.

Job Description:
At Regions, the End User Computing (EUC) Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining desktop solutions that leverage various technologies and platforms. This role collaborates with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, design scalable and secure architectures, and ensure a smooth deployment and operation of desktop environments.
Responsibilities

Designs end-to-end desktop solutions by analyzing business requirements, assessing existing infrastructure, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance architectures
Designs and integrates application and desktop products, including virtual apps and desktops, to provide comprehensive and cohesive desktop solutions
Configures and manages virtual machines, session hosts, virtual networks, and storage to create and maintain virtual desktop environments
Ensures proper image management, user profile management, and application delivery mechanisms
Designs and configures network connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud serves, including network security measures, such as firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers, to ensure secure and efficient data transfer
Optimizes desktop environments for performance, scalability, and user experience
Monitors and tunes resource allocation, load balancing, and network bandwidth to ensure optimal performance
Implements security measures, including data encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements, to protect desktop environments and ensure compliance with industry regulations and organizational policies
Designs and implements high availability and disaster recovery solutions to minimize downtime and data loss
Creates redundancy mechanisms, backup strategies, and failover mechanisms to ensure business continuity
Assist with the set-up of monitoring tools and processes to proactively monitor desktop infrastructure
Identifies and troubleshoots performance issues, system errors, and network connectivity problems to maintain a stable and reliable environment
Creates design documentation, implementation guides, and operational procedures, policy documents and controls
Leads and coordinates with cross functional teams, to design and provide a timely resolution to all escalated issues related to the service. These cross functional teams include among others, support teams, agent owners, security and network teams and application SME's
Writes, tests, validates, and installs packages for software upgrades/patches
Provides support for incidents and problems escalated from our tier 1 and 2 support teams with a particular focus on PC hardware, operating systems, peripherals, and other issues

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field and four (4) years designing and implementing desktop solutions
Or High School Diploma/GED and eight (8) years designing and implementing desktop solutions
Experience in network design, including connectivity options, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers

Preferences

Related certifications in A+, Azure, Citrix, Jamf, Microsoft technologies, etc.

Skills and Competencies

Ability to work with minimal supervision
Excellent customer service skills
Familiarity with identity and access management concepts
Knowledge of operating systems
Knowledge of security best practices, data encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements
Knowledge of systems automation tools including PowerShell, VB scripting, or Shell scripting
Knowledge of typical server applications and services, (SCCM, SQL, Active Directory, WSUS, GPOs, Jamf, etc.)
Knowledge of virtual desktop services
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual skills
Strong verbal and written communications skills
Understanding of performance optimization techniques, monitoring tools, and troubleshooting methodologies

macOS & Jamf Pro Engineering Responsibilities

Implement and support Jamf Pro configurations including configuration profiles, policies, smart groups, inventory collection, and enrollment workflows.
Assist with Zero-Touch Provisioning for macOS using Automated Device Enrollment (ADE) through Apple Business Manager.
Apply and maintain macOS configuration baselines aligned with Bank security standards, CIS benchmarks, and MDM capabilities.
Create and maintain macOS packages, scripts, and automation to support software deployment, patching, and endpoint configuration.
Support integrations between Jamf Pro and enterprise systems such as identity providers, certificate services, and security platforms.
Participate in macOS version lifecycle activities including testing, validation, phased deployments, and user communications.
Leverage Jamf Pro APIs and built‑in tooling to support reporting, remediation workflows, inventory accuracy, and configuration compliance.
Develop and maintain scripts (bash, zsh, or Python) to assist with Jamf automation, macOS compliance checks, and provisioning tasks.

macOS Platform Knowledge

Demonstrated working knowledge of macOS system behavior including permissions, FileVault, MDM concepts, and security features.
Experience using Apple Business Manager capabilities such as ADE and VPP for application deployment and device lifecycle support.
Support macOS identity and authentication integrations, including certificates, SSO, and modern authentication methods.
Stay current with Apple platform updates and new capabilities, contributing recommendations to improve reliability, security, and user experience.

Troubleshooting & Operational Support

Serve as an escalation resource for macOS and Jamf Pro issues requiring advanced troubleshooting beyond standard support queues.
Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and identity teams to support standardized macOS endpoint management across the Bank.
Contribute to engineering documentation including build procedures, configuration standards, deployment guides, and operational runbooks.

Preferred macOS / Jamf Experience

Jamf certification at the 200 or 300 level (or equivalent hands-on experience).
Experience supporting macOS devices in enterprise or regulated environments.
Familiarity with macOS security tooling such as Jamf Protect, EDR platforms, certificate services, and OS hardening practices.
Exposure to integrating macOS into environments with Windows-centric tooling (e.g., Intune Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender).

Required Skills & Qualifications Strong understanding of Windows OS and enterprise application deployment processes. Hands-on experience with SCCM/MECM, InstallShield, CyberArk EPM, and Intune. Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and PSADT for automation. Knowledge of application security, vulnerability management, and compliance standards. Familiarity with VMware, SQL databases, and enterprise identity platforms like Microsoft Entra. Excellent documentation skills for technical specifications and risk assessments. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Operations, Security). Preferred Qualifications Experience in software lifecycle management and QA processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of Windows Hello for Business integration and troubleshooting.

jobs.description:
Endpoint Platform Staff Engineer

THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As a Staff Endpoint Platform Engineer, you are the technical anchor of our endpoint fleet strategy - responsible for setting the course for how FanDuel manages, automates, and secures its device fleet at scale. You own the architecture. You drive the roadmap. You define what "secure and well-managed" means across macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows - and you build the systems, patterns, and standards that make it durable long after you've moved on to the next problem.

This isn't an execution-only role. You'll partner across Security, Enterprise Technology, and more to translate complex, ambiguous operational challenges into coherent platform solutions - and you'll mentor the engineers around you to do the same. You bring deep craft, organizational influence, and a bias toward solving problems permanently rather than repeatedly.

You will report to the Sr. Manager of Cyber Defense Engineering.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Define and own the multi-year technical strategy for FanDuel's global endpoint fleet - establishing engineering principles and reusable configuration patterns that set the standard for how our team builds and operates.

• Architect and drive delivery of scalable, secure-by-default device baselines across macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows - ensuring every device in the fleet is compliant, performant, and trusted from zero-touch provisioning through offboarding.

• Lead the design and implementation of GitOps-driven endpoint configuration management and CI/CD validation pipelines - ensuring platform changes are peer-reviewed, auditable, and resistant to configuration drift.

• Define the KPIs that matter - provisioning speed, compliance drift, patch latency, device trust posture - and build the telemetry and automation to track, report on, and continuously improve them.

• Mentor and develop engineers on the team by modeling technical excellence, providing thoughtful feedback, and investing in their craft.

• Proactively identify platform risks, technical debt, and emerging opportunities - and intervene when work is off-course to change direction before it becomes a bigger problem.

• Use AI as a force multiplier - for automation, operational efficiency, and engineering quality - across everything you do.

• Support the security organization as necessary. Anything is possible when we operate as one team.

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

• Extensive hands-on experience architecting, designing, and managing large-scale Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and enterprise MDM platforms at scale - think Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, FleetDM, or equivalent - across multi-OS enterprise environments.

• Proven track record owning a platform strategy end-to-end - defining the roadmap, building alignment, navigating tradeoffs, and delivering durable outcomes across organizational boundaries.

• Strong automation and platform engineering depth - proficiency in Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python

• Hands-on experience deploying Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent) and GitOps workflows in production.

• Deep understanding of endpoint and mobile security ecosystems across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows -Microsoft MAM, Secure Remote Access/Conditional Access approaches, and endpoint protection are a few you can expect to have impact in.

• Track record of mentoring and developing engineers - sharing knowledge broadly through documentation, design reviews, and direct coaching; actively participating in hiring and calibration for senior roles.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills - you can diagnose a complex fleet issue, translate the fix to non-technical stakeholders, and write the architecture doc that prevents the next one.

• Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments - able to set direction with incomplete information, raise blockers early, and drive to decisions even when consensus is hard.

ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits , pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here:
FanDuel Total Rewards . *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

The applicable salary range for this position is $146,000-$182,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.
